changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwwallettransactions AS SELECT wt.id, wt.patient_id, wt.type, wt.amount, wt.reference_id, wt.created_date FROM public.wallet_transactions wt;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwwallettransactions TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwwallettransactions FROM report_user;
